description: This file defines the IUserService interface, which provides an abstraction for user-related operations such as authentication, user creation, email and password management, and user status toggling within the OrchardCore project.

classes.name: IUserService
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for user authentication, creation, modification, retrieval, and status management.

methods.name: AuthenticateAsync
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials given a username or email and password, reporting errors if any.

methods.name: CreateUserAsync
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified user details and password, reporting errors if any.

methods.name: ChangeEmailAsync
methods.description: Changes the email address of a user, returning true if successful.

methods.name: ChangePasswordAsync
methods.description: Changes the password of a user, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetAuthenticatedUserAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the authenticated user associated with a given ClaimsPrincipal.

methods.name: GetUserAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by username or email.

methods.name: GetUserByUniqueIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: GetForgotPasswordUserAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user with a forgotten password by user ID.

methods.name: ResetPasswordAsync
methods.description: Resets a user's password using a reset token, reporting success or failure.

methods.name: CreatePrincipalAsync
methods.description: Creates a ClaimsPrincipal object for a user.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a new user based on a registration form, reporting errors if any.
